Board of Library Commissioners Agendas and Meetings

  1. Home /
  2. Board of Library Commissioners

About the BLC Meetings

Library Commission Meetings are held every other Thursday at 11:00 a.m. at the Central Library, Board Room, Level 4, 630 West 5th Street, Los Angeles, CA 90071. From time to time, the Commission may hold meetings at branch libraries throughout the City. Meetings will be conducted in person and online via Zoom.
